verdict.rationale: Kling documents an Elements system in 3.0 Omni that keeps a character's identity and voice persistent across multiple shots and scenes. This directly targets cross-shot consistency, and multi-shot storyboarding of up to 6 cuts plus a 'consistent visual style' across image series support it. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how Elements works and its limits, explicit evidence of scene/environment (not just character) persistence across separate generations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
